R7BF-grouse-drive-0001.name: 1.1 km NW of Pocketknife Creek
R7BF-grouse-drive-0001.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).
R7BF-grouse-drive-0001.parkWhat: pull off on an unnamed gravel road

evidence.t: 100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
10 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

seasonRows.notes: MU 7-42 is not listed in the Region 7B sharp tailed grouse rows (my reading of the table).

plan: Drive: from Buckinghorse River, about 27 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 97.
Park: 57.54648, -123.0278, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the unnamed road stretch, 4.4 km one way. About 87 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Sept, Oct, Nov (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 7-42, Region 7B. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-06-30, closures 2026-10-16.
R7BF-grouse-drive-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 7-42: about 6,652 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.10 days per square km, middle third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).
